moments.text: Infrared sensor view over layers of bright cloud against darker sky. A small white spot wanders close to the crosshair.
The cloud thins to scattered puffs; the white spot keeps drifting around the crosshair, often below or left of it.
The picture flashes white, then flat grey.
Closer view of plain grey sky with faint vertical stripes; the spot, larger now, moves between above the crosshair and its upper right.
After a dark flicker the wider view returns with scattered cloud; the spot moves around below and beside the crosshair.
A square box appears on the crosshair while the spot stays off to one side, passing near small clouds.
The picture flashes white, then blocky grey.
A field of large rounded clouds fills the view; the spot moves among them near the crosshair.
The cloud clears to plain grey, then faint ground patches and lines appear below; the spot stays near the crosshair.
Two quick white flashes; between them a wider view with a brighter band across the top.
Closer view of the ground: the spot, larger, moves from left of the crosshair to the upper right and shows bright near the top.
